description: deviation.rs:apply_deviations iterates ALL raw findings — including Pass and NotApplicable — and will match them against the deviation store. If a deviation store entry matches a lint that returned Pass, the Pass finding will be moved to deviated output. This is semantically wrong: deviations should only be applied to actionable findings (Warn, Error, Fatal). Applying a deviation to Pass is misleading — it implies a waiver was needed but the cert actually passed. Fix: in apply_deviations, only call find_deviation when finding.result.is_finding() is true; otherwise unconditionally push to findings.
title: DeviationRunner.apply_deviations deviate Pass/NotApplicable findings
